name: agent-token-reality-index
description: AI-agent tokens with two reads: (1) paper ratio = 1 − (real DEX liquidity ÷ market cap) — how un-cashable the "market cap" is; (2) a contract-safety verdict (honeypot/mint/owner-control/tax).
source: DexScreener (live liquidity/mcap) + GoPlus Security (live contract safety, EVM + Solana)

api.description: Want this programmatically, on any token? Token-safety + exit-liquidity as a pay-per-call API for agents — no signup, x402 (USDC on Base).

methodology: paperPct = max(0, 1 − liquidityUsd/marketCapUsd); realLiquidityUsd = deepest single-pool USD liquidity. safety.rating ∈ {clean, minor-flags, caution, high-risk} from GoPlus flags (honeypot/cannot-sell/owner-reclaim/hidden-owner = high-risk).
disclaimer: Informational, not financial advice. Liquidity + contract state change fast. Verified-canonical contracts only.
